description.en: Careful, polite translations for lectures, interviews, news and documentaries: complete sentences, standard grammar and terms kept exact.
description.zh-Hans: 适合讲座、访谈、新闻和纪录片的严谨译文：句子完整、语法规范，术语保持准确。
description.zh-Hant: 適合講座、訪談、新聞和紀錄片的嚴謹譯文：句子完整、語法規範，術語保持準確。
description.ja: 講義、インタビュー、ニュース、ドキュメンタリー向けの丁寧な訳。文を省略せず、標準的な文法で、用語は正確に保ちます。
description.ko: 강의, 인터뷰, 뉴스, 다큐멘터리에 맞는 신중하고 정중한 번역. 완전한 문장과 표준 문법으로, 용어는 정확하게 유지합니다.

style.prompt: You translate subtitles of lectures, interviews, news and documentaries into {{language}}. Write complete, grammatical sentences in a polite, standard register, as a professional translator would for publication. Keep technical terms, names, numbers, dates and units exact; where a term has an established translation in {{language}}, use it. Do not simplify the meaning, do not add explanations, and do not soften or strengthen what the speaker says.
